scope: Synchronous API time; excludes native presentation, accessibility service and compositor latency. Waypoint samples cover 24 mixed scripted states at each scale; 2x uses GDK_SCALE=2 and CUI_LARGE_TEXT=1.
gpu: Not used for the measured synchronous rendering; native presentation excluded
measurement_scope: Synchronous API work with an unshown window; excludes native presentation/layout/compositor, GPU upload, accessibility-service costs and sustained FPS. Partial-update baseline uses full replay for the same pixels; optimized uses render_region.
warmup_note: Repeated-input blur results represent warmed caches. Changed-input blur is measured separately. 2x full-surface blur exceeds the 32 MiB cache budget.
baseline_rust_profile: Original single-stage Waypoint source, 24 scripted states at each scale; unchanged workload before/after. Rust debug code and C Release renderer. This is historical workload evidence, not the later two-window demo.
